reviews.title: Great case, designed for people who enjoy putting together computers.
reviews.comment: Case was fantastic for cable management and thoughtfully put together, especially if you have the older 3.5/2.5 style hard drives. Lights are beautiful. The one thing that is tricky is the tin panel that goes between the super IO board on the motherboard and the case itself. We had to remove the chassis fan on the back to get that piece to slide into place. Everything else was easy.
reviews.author: Kristina F.

reviews.title: A lot of Case for the money!
reviews.comment: I gotta admit. I am a fan of Phanteks cases. This case has so much going for it. For starters, it's big and easy to work in. I can get my big hands in everywhere I need to. Their are no sharp edges. The fans look great and airflow is good with the stock fans. Massive room for large cpu coolers (I'm using double tower). The usual phanteks attention to detail is there ( a single front connector is awesome!) and accessories include ample screws, ties ect.... The case is not perfect though. Construction is a lot lighter than in the more expensive phanteks cases. The side screws are not captive or hinged. I do wish there was a little more connectivity up front, too. Overall, I can easily recommend this case at this price point.
reviews.author: james karl  krantz

reviews.title: Good product and will get more when need to get another gamer tower
reviews.comment: I got two of these gaming towers for me and family member and we love them.
reviews.author: Helena

reviews.title: Solid Case w/ Fans for a Small Price
reviews.comment: A solid case especially at this price point.  If I had to complain about something, maybe the included fans are a little noisy.  But, for the most part, it's an easy case to work with.  I was able to stuff 6 SATA SSD's in it.  And it seems to have pretty decent airflow.
reviews.author: William Z.

reviews.title: Beautiful case with amazing airflow.
reviews.comment:
Amazing case well worth the money. Airflow for days keeping my temps well below TDP.
Pro: a breeze to build with this case offers so many options for cable management.
Fit my chunky 4070 and full atx mother board with room to spare.
Removable Hard drive case made it super easy.
Cons: issues getting glass door in just right.
reviews.author: Jacob
